name: call-anyone-mcp
description: Plan and place outbound phone calls in the callee's language with your own Bland or Twilio account: language detection, goal-based script, cost estimate and a preview you must confirm before any call. Then fetch transcript and summary. The caller always discloses it's an AI; emergency and premium numbers are blocked.

BLAND_API_KEY.title: Bland API key
BLAND_API_KEY.description: Your own Bland AI API key. Needed only to place calls through Bland.

TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID.title: Twilio Account SID
TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID.description: Your own Twilio Account SID. Use instead of Bland.

TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER.title: Twilio caller number
TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER.description: A Twilio number you own, in E.164 format.
